tracks.title: Gateway messaging
tracks.intro: Connect a dedicated Android phone and SIM, send and receive SMS through the server, and report outcomes honestly.

capabilities.name: Phone + SIM enrollment and device stream
done: One-use pairing with code and key-fingerprint comparison
P-256 device keys in Android Keystore with challenge-response sign-in
Authenticated WebSocket stream with heartbeats, fenced session epochs and bounded reconnects
Opt-in heartbeat resumes after a phone reboot
Controlled test on one Samsung device and SIM ([compatibility notes](DEVICE-COMPATIBILITY.md))
todo: Longer liveness runs across networks, carriers and device models
Supported-device guidance

capabilities.name: Outbound send with honest delivery states
done: Durable idempotency keys and per-account admission budgets
One radio operation at a time, with an execution grant bound to device, attempt and recipient
Ambiguous submissions become `unknown` and are never retried automatically ([state model](ARCHITECTURE.md#message-semantics-and-the-duplicate-send-problem))
Allowlisted synthetic send route (`/v1/alpha/messages`)
todo: Planned public `/v1/messages` route that accepts sealed content
Open to any account, after the [path to general sending](#path-to-general-sending) is complete

capabilities.name: Opt-out handling and recipient suppression
done: STOP, STOPALL, UNSUBSCRIBE and similar keywords recognized in the outbound reply window
Likely free-text withdrawals create a conservative block marked for review
Account-scoped suppression checked when a message is accepted
Local block on the phone applies immediately, even while offline
Local line binding and unsolicited opt-outs journaled on the phone ([#210](https://github.com/pboachie/zrotext/pull/210))
todo: Authenticated capture beyond the outbound reply window
Durable line ID bound to server-side inbound actions
Owner workflow for off-channel and ambiguous requests

capabilities.name: Inbound capture and signed webhooks
done: Bounded inbound SMS pilot on Android with signed metadata upload
Durable webhook outbox with HMAC signatures, retries and bounded manual replay
Webhook signing secrets encrypted at rest, with key rotation ([runbook](WEBHOOK-KEK-ROTATION.md))
Retention limits for inbound content and delivery history
todo: Reliable inbound when senders use RCS ([details](ANDROID-TESTING.md))
Sealed inbound content delivered to customer decryptors

capabilities.name: Owner dashboard: device health and history
done: Device pairing and management page
Authenticated connection lease shown per device
Message state timeline, inbound activity and webhook history views
todo: SIM, queue depth and radio readiness per device
Live updates instead of snapshots
